meta.title: Conspiracy beliefs
meta.question: Do Poles think hidden forces shape events?
meta.measure: Average belief that hidden forces or conspiracies shape events, from 0 (disbelief) to 10 (strong belief)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on whether hidden forces or conspiracies shape events in Poland and the world, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: It is not the government that rules us; those who really steer us are not known to us at all (strongly agree ... strongly disagree)
Those who say that there are powerful hidden forces in the world conspiring against Poland are largely right (strongly agree ... strongly disagree)
It is not the government that rules us; those really in control are unknown (agree ... disagree)
Powerful hidden forces are conspiring against Poland (agree ... disagree)
Certain secret groups control all important decisions in the world (definitely yes, rather yes, yes and no, rather no, definitely no)
It is not the government that rules us; those who really steer us are not known at all (agree ... disagree)
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker wave 14 (July 2021), online; the CBOS/PGSW wording.
